title: NSGo game 3D foliage layers (version 1)
description: FoliageDoc is the root of a versioned YAML foliage definition declaring one or more procedural foliage scatter layers over a terrain heightmap.

version.description: Version is the schema version; must be 1.

name.description: Name is an optional human-readable name for the foliage set.

terrain.description: Terrain is an optional asset path to the terrain definition (*.terrain.yaml) these foliage layers scatter over.

layers.description: Layers lists 1 or more procedural foliage scatter layers in authoring order.

FoliageLayerDoc.description: FoliageLayerDoc describes one procedural foliage scatter layer in a [FoliageDoc].

name.description: Name is the unique identifier for this foliage layer (such as "grass", "pine_tree", "boulder").

mesh.description: Mesh is the asset path to the foliage mesh (such as a .gltf or .glb model).

material.description: Material is an optional asset path to a material override for the foliage mesh.

densityMap.description: DensityMap is an optional asset path to a grayscale density mask image covering the terrain bounds.

density.description: Density is the target candidate instances per square meter; set either density or spacing (not both).

spacing.description: Spacing is the target average world-space spacing between instances in meters (equivalent to density = 1 / spacing^2); set either spacing or density (not both).

minScale.description: MinScale is the minimum uniform instance scale; omitted defaults to 1 (or maxScale when only maxScale is set).

maxScale.description: MaxScale is the maximum uniform instance scale; omitted defaults to 1 (or minScale when only minScale is set).

alignToNormal.description: AlignToNormal blends instance up-axis alignment from upright (0) to terrain surface normal (1).

minSlopeDeg.description: MinSlopeDeg is the minimum terrain slope in degrees [0, 90] where instances may spawn.

maxSlopeDeg.description: MaxSlopeDeg is the maximum terrain slope in degrees [0, 90] where instances may spawn; 0 with minSlopeDeg 0 allows all slopes.

minHeight.description: MinHeight is the minimum world-space Y elevation where instances may spawn.

maxHeight.description: MaxHeight is the maximum world-space Y elevation where instances may spawn.

baseMaxDistance.description: BaseMaxDistance is the default maximum draw distance in world units; 0 means uncapped unless limited by QualityProfile.

boundingRadius.description: BoundingRadius is the bounding sphere radius at scale 1 around the mesh pivot for frustum culling and distance fade; 0 defaults to 1 around the pivot.

seed.description: Seed is the deterministic PRNG seed for repeatable scattering.
